name: @finapp/m27-finance-ai
description: M27 — Finance AI (Stage 5, GOVERNED, mvp:partial): AI assistance for reconciliation and finance — reconciliation match suggestions (with confidence), transaction/exception classification, anomaly detection, risk flagging and journal-recommendation drafting — every output a human-reviewed, EXPLAINABLE SUGGESTION. NEVER AUTO-POSTS, never approves, never auto-matches, never auto-reconciles, never closes an exception and never mutates a finance record; suggestions feed DRAFT journals + human approval only (CLAUDE.md no-autopost hard rule). It reuses the M24 governed AI gateway BY CONTRACT (no second AI engine, no provider/routing/DLP), references M15/M15a bank-recon + M20 GL-recon subjects by OPAQUE id (reads no m15/m20 table; matching stays owned by M15a, GL recon by M20), audits every action under the shared AI_ prefix (AI_FINANCE_*), shares the m24 ai.* permission namespace, and owns NO second outbox and NO new event family. Money is bigint minor units (never float, ADR-007); a suggestion is never a confirmed accounting fact. No production provider, no network, no HTTP client.
